name: Ultimate Metro (Prototype)
summary: Private direction research: compare tram modes and native track behavior. Not a working metro.
description: Revision 10 adds a separate UM Direction Probe (Test) with three disconnected segments: A the proven single-lane STREET tram profile, B the same profile plus TRAM_TRACK/ELECTRIC_TRAM_TRACK modes, C native electrified TRACK as reference. Read-only probes inspect generated native edges and pathfinding in each direction and mode. This tests whether adding rail modes is sufficient for reverse paths; it does not isolate every difference between native STREET and TRACK implementations. No station, vehicle command or tram/rail transition is added by this fixture. Existing station scripts and profiles are unchanged. Single-lane stop binding and a forward six-edge path via ordinary tramtrack were confirmed in revision 9; native reversal remains unproven. Place only one fixture on free flat land, run ten seconds, inspect logs. Do not use the withdrawn duplicate-edge revision 6.
